address: 114 Mai Hac De Street, Le Dai Hanh Ward, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi, 11606, Vietnam
bio: This small bún chả shop has been serving loyal customers for over 10 years. In addition to the typical caramelised pork meatballs on rice vermicelli, you can ask for grilled pork belly or minced beef in betel leaf to go with the noodles – all served with a tangy, sweet broth. The spring roll, deep-fried to order, boasts crispy skin and a juicy filling with layers of rich flavours. Open until noon only, so come early to avoid missing out....
